Cancellation is untouched (separate `status → cancelled` → `game_deleted` branch still fires), as is completion (`game_result`) and creation (`game_created`). Applied at the trigger so it covers sv-sync, bp-sync AND manual reschedules uniformly. A pure venue/hall-only change is intentionally muted too (SV hall is frozen anyway; can add `hall` to the gate later if manual venue moves should ping). Also cleared the existing backlog: **2066** `game_updated` rows (2018 unread) deleted from prod `notifications` for a clean slate. Migration 199 (schema-only, `CREATE OR REPLACE`); `SCHEMA.sql` updated to match. Deploy gotcha: the first chained `db:snapshot:prod && db:migrate:prod` reported "✓ Up to date" and silently no-op'd (transient `psql`-over-ssh read during the busy snapshot window made `getApplied()` return a bad tracker set) — verified prod had NOT applied (no tracker row, gate absent), re-ran `db:migrate:prod` standalone → applied cleanly. **dev+prod** (dev fa5624f8, prod cherry-pick f17be51e). No frontend/version bump (backend-only).
- **2026-07-09** **Stale-version recovery: cache-busting reload** — the "A new version is available / Reload" screen (`chunkReload.ts` recovery, shown after a deploy rotates hashed chunk names and a stale tab can't import a now-gone chunk → CF SPA-fallback HTML rejected by `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`) could get *stuck*: `reloadNow()` + the auto-reload paths used `window.location.reload()`, which a privacy extension / corporate proxy can satisfy from a stale cached index.html, so repeated reloads kept returning the same broken document (user-reported: "Reload doesn't work"). Fix: new internal `hardReload()` navigates via `location.replace()` with a unique `?_v=<ts36>` cache-bust param — a fresh URL cannot be served from any HTTP cache, so the current index.html (which only references chunks that exist) is guaranteed to load; `location.replace` (not reload) also keeps the broken state out of back-history. `stripCacheBustParam()` strips it synchronously in `main.tsx` before React/the router mount, so it never enters routing or accumulates in the URL bar. Every reload path routed through it: auto `reloadOnce` (vite:preloadError / bootstrap catch / global error+unhandledrejection listeners), user-clicked `reloadNow`, and both generic `SentryFallback` (App) / `SchedulingFallback` "Reload page" buttons. The 10s cooldown loop-guard is unchanged. Diagnosis note: the live prod deploy was verified self-consistent at incident time (index.html `no-store` → entry `index-CFrxQ8__.js` → App + all ~30 boot chunks 200 `application/javascript`) and the push SW is fetch-handler-less, so the screenshot was a transient deploy-propagation race — this change just makes the recovery bulletproof so a stuck client can always escape. Frontend-only, no schema/endpoint; build+lint green, 582/582 unit tests pass. **dev+prod**.

Selecting team(s) narrows the WHOLE modal — summary counts, member list, waitlist, coaching-staff section and all three exports (CSV/PNG/PDF) — to those teams; default "All teams". Design: fetches key on the full roster (`rosterMemberIds`), so switching teams recomputes counts from the already-loaded participations with **no refetch** (`useCollection` keys structurally). `useMultiTeamMembers` extended with a `teamsByMember` map built from the RAW junction rows (before the member-dedupe drops the 2nd team) so a player shared across two invited teams shows under either; staff narrowing via a new per-team coach/TR map (`leadershipTeamsByMember`). i18n `allTeams`/`teamsCount`/`filterByTeam` ×5. - **2026-07-07** **Error-log triage: archive/important buttons, bulk actions, class-level mute rules (commit `d3e64348`, migration 179, dev+prod).** The Error Logs page was collecting non-bug noise nobody could act on — mistyped-password logins (`auth_error` "Invalid user credentials") and transient mobile "Load failed" network drops (`network_error`). Three-part fix: **(1) Source** — `captureAuthError` (`src/lib/sentry.ts`) now carves out `login` + "Invalid user credentials" (logs at `warn`, skips Sentry), mirroring the existing token-expired carve-out, so a wrong password never pages Sentry or logs at error level. The transient network case was already carved out. **(2) Schema (migration 179)** — new `error_mute_rules` table (`event` + case-insensitive message substring, `enabled`, actor) that hides a WHOLE category from the default view, unlike per-hash `error_annotations` which only hide one occurrence (hash = md5 of ts|event|error, so noise recurs daily with a fresh hash). Raw-knex-only like `error_annotations`, no `directus_fields` registration. Seeded idempotently with the two known-noise categories. **(3) Backend** — `GET /admin/error-logs` applies enabled mute rules (an explicit `important` annotation still wins over a category mute); new `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /admin/error-logs/mute-rules` (requireAdmin + `writeUserLog` actor capture). **(4) Frontend** — per-row Archive/Important/Reopen buttons, row-checkbox bulk-archive, "Mute all like this" inline form, a mute-rules management panel, and the "Show solved" toggle relabelled "Show archived" (reveals solved + muted). en/de i18n. Also archived today's three noise entries on prod via `annotate-bulk` before the fix. **Deploy**: dev `db:migrate:dev` (179 ✓, seeds verified) → push (frontend) → `ext:deploy:dev` → CRUD round-trip verified. Prod: `db:migrate:prod` → `ext:deploy:prod`. `setup-perms` skipped (no permission delta — endpoints are admin-only via `requireAdmin`, table is internal raw-knex). No version bump (user opted out of changelog for this).

- **2026-07-07** **Two mail forwards that couldn't land, both fixed by not forwarding (commit `0898a1df`, migration 178, dev+prod).** Root pattern: **Migadu transparent forwarding keeps the original `From:`, so any forward from a strict-auth sender is refused/quarantined at the receiver — silently** (nothing in Pending/Spam, refused at SMTP; the forward leg isn't even in Migadu's traffic logs). **(1) `volleyball@spielplanung.kscw.ch` → Google Group `vb_spieplanung_kscw@googlegroups.com`**: forward kept `From: gs-mk@svrz.ch` (svrz.ch = M365, SPF `-all`, NO DMARC) → Google Groups spoof-**rejected** it; the July 5 "AW: Döltschi Gym" never posted. Proof was in the group itself — only soft-auth senders (gmail/swissonline/proton/own domain) ever posted, no `svrz.ch`-origin msg ever did. **Fix = "option 4" remailer** (`scheduling-mailbox.js` `repostInboundToGroup`, wired into the 10-min `runMailboxSync` cron): re-mails qualifying inbound **AS the mailbox** (DKIM-aligned for `spielplanung.kscw.ch` → authenticates → posts), `Reply-To` = original sender, forwarded-header block, attachments incl. inline CID preserved, threaded; scope = **human correspondence only** (skips amazonses/no-reply/bounce); loop-safe (skips self/group/`List-Id`/`X-Google-Group-Id`/own `X-KSCW-Group-Repost` + Message-ID dedup); reuses the existing `EMAIL_SMTP_*` SES transport. **Migration 178** adds `scheduling_emails.group_reposted_at` (cron bookkeeping) + **seals the backlog** so first run doesn't dump 60 days. Gated by `SCHEDULING_GROUP_REPOST_COMMIT` (**prod=1** actually posts, **dev unset** = dry-run that logs "would post" + stamps, so dev never double-posts off the shared mailbox); `SCHEDULING_GROUP_ADDRESS` (code-defaulted), `SCHEDULING_GROUP_REPOST_WINDOW_DAYS=3`. **(2) Expense reimbursements never reached the treasurer**: `expense-upload.js` mailed only `finance@mail.kscw.ch` → forwarded to `radovanovic.radomir@kscw.ch` = **ClubDesk** (`kscw.ch`, DMARC `p=quarantine`) → quarantined the softfail forwarded copy. **Fix**: send **directly** to the treasurer's real inbox via SES too — new env `FINANCE_NOTIFY_EMAILS` (default `radomir.radovanovic.b@gmail.com`, the Gmail approval mail already reaches him at), `finance@` kept as archive CC, **empty on dev**. **Deploy**: dev `deploy:dev` (migration 178 applied, ext restart, dry-run validated — the July 5 svrz.ch msg logged "would post"). Prod: `db:migrate:prod` (snapshot first) → ext staged (no restart) → **user deleted the Migadu group forward** (prevents dups) → `SCHEDULING_GROUP_REPOST_COMMIT=1` added to `/opt/directus-kscw/.env` → **container recreated** (env-file change) → live-validated: un-sealed prod row 11401 → 00:10 cron **`posted` the July 5 message to the group for real** (SES accepted; user confirms Google display). INFRA.md env tables updated (finance §, mailbox §). `setup-perms` skipped (no permission delta — the new column is internal raw-knex bookkeeping). ⚠ Working tree carries unrelated parallel `src/` WIP (ErrorLogsPage + nav) — committed only my 3 files.

New `finance_expenses` collection (**migration 177** — renumbered from a stale WIP 175 after 176 landed on dev; `member` FK is `ON DELETE RESTRICT` per migration 174's audit-preservation rule) gives every submission a `pending → paid | rejected` lifecycle. `/kscw/expenses/submit` now persists the row (email kept as belt-and-braces side channel; a mail failure no longer 500s once the row is saved, killing the duplicate-on-retry path). - **2026-07-07** **19 mangled ClubDesk duplicate contacts cleaned + root-cause dup-guard shipped (prod).** Discovered 19 garbage duplicate contacts with accented chars corrupted to `?` (C?dric, B?rkli, Cl?ver, Jo?l, M?ller, …), each shadowing a correct linked twin (all 'Kein Mitglied', unlinked). **Root cause**: the up-dispatcher (`clubdesk-member-up-dispatch.sh`) previewed the UPDATE set but only checked the preview *reached its summary* — it never inspected `neu`. When a name failed to match its stored contact (ClubDesk decodes some CP1252 high-bytes to `?` on import), ClubDesk offered to CREATE it and the dispatcher committed anyway → mangled dup. My push pipeline itself is clean end-to-end (verified: shell→up_csv keeps `c3bc`, dispatcher pull+iconv→`fc`); the gap was the missing commit guard. **Fix**: dispatcher now REFUSES the update-set commit whenever the preview reports `neu>0` (an update push must only match, never create) — mechanism-independent, catches any future encoding/name-drift regression (repo prod `4a0996a4` + deployed to VPS). **Cleanup**: wrote a conservative delete-scraper (exact name-cell match on the mangled `Nachname Vorname`, excludes Kaspar's real `Curavi?`, verifies each row gone before counting) → deleted all 19; re-pushed the licence/officials/sex data (Offiziellen Lizenz, Schiedsrichter, Lizenznummer, Lizenzart, Geschlecht) that had gone to the dups back onto the 17 correct contacts (veraendert=17, neu=0). End state: 1149 contacts, only Kaspar's legitimate `Curavi?` mangled (ć genuinely can't be CP1252).
